fieldValues.title: RFC-053: A Field's id travels beside its name in machine-facing outputs
fieldValues.author: agent:rfc-drafter (draft); the owner accepted it 2026-11-05 on the-greenman/srs#998
fieldValues.affected_components:
The authoring projection (`x-srs-field-id` on every property, at every depth), per-field facets under `ext:discovery` (one facet per Field, carrying `fieldId`), `docs/schema/2.0/projection-rules.md`, the prose retirement of the keyword in RFC-039's Blast radius section. No stored shape, no JSON schema file, no `dataModelRevision` bump.

fieldValues.dependency_refs: Applies rfc-decision-b2ff7c91. Amends the surfaces of RFC-012 (Door 3) and RFC-035 (Door 3), and reverses one prose statement of RFC-039 (non-normative row). Consults rfc-decision-cce3c00e, rfc-decision-7d3dda60, rfc-decision-9ee14517. Adjacent: the-greenman/srs#366. Records its decisions as rfc-decision-51974ac3 and rfc-decision-43e84d63.
fieldValues.content: A field name is a label, unique only within one Type. An implementation reports a Field's id beside its name in the two outputs where clients meet field names: each authoring-projection property carries `x-srs-field-id`, and each field facet is one Field carrying `fieldId`. Records stay keyed by `Field.name`, and nothing stored changes. Full text: rfcs/rfc-053-field-id-beside-field-name.md.
